proposals.evidence: DEDR5276 explicitly gives Tamil valiya strong/big, Malayalam valiya great, Kannada bal(u)/bolu bigness and Kodagu ballyë great. These southern survey valiya/baliya/belliya-type big adjectives extend that documented family, retaining ordinary adjective endings and source vowel/length notation. The right-hand sense of the current parent is only one sense: its primary article directly supports bigness. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
